notes.title: Astro Pig Released! + Garoa Hits vol. 1
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 This May 1st we've launched Astro Pig - our lo-fi adventure puzzle platformer - on Steam! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1800390/Astro_Pig/

With the launch we've also updated our [b]Garoa Hits - vol. 1[/b] bundle! If you've missed any Garoa classic titles' launch, take a look and grab this chance to complete your collection!

📦 The bundle includes:

[list]
[*] Cartomante (2020)
[*] Stand By Me (2021)
[*] Cat Leather Jackets (2023)
[*] Astro Pig (2024)[/list]
💿 The bundle only adds to your cart titles you don't have in your library, and applies a discount over the total value! We think it's also a great gift for that special someone that enjoys brazilian games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38548/Garoa_Hits__vol_1/?curator_clanid=4777282

notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - BIG Festival 2021 Finalist! (and minor fixes)
notes.content:
[url=https://twitter.com/garoastudios/status/1377395485112070150][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ex1913iWgAM__Sb?format=jpg&name=medium[/img][/url]

We are proud to announce Cartomante was listed as a finalist in the "Best Brazilian Game" category for BIG Festival 2021, LATAM's biggest independent games event! 

BIG will happen from May 3rd to the 9th, and [url=https://www.bigfestival.com.br/index.html]you can register here![/url]

We also did some minor quality of life fixes:

- Fixed UI anchors in the pause menu;
- Removed the possibility of the pause menu bugging out by repeatedly pressing the escape key.
